Hatch a Carbuncle, Fat Cat, Moogle, Namazu, Fluffy Shepherd, or Deviruchi, pet & gift friends' companions, invite nearby players to battle Level-Scaled Mini-Bosses with a shared Limit Break, level up to Lv.100 across ALL FFXIV content, equip all 43 Job weapons & tools, and customize Hats, Outfits, Wings, Weapon Auras, and RGB Colors.
